newsitem.title: USA: Team may sell half stake to Wingate Partners.
newsitem.headline: Team may sell half stake to Wingate Partners.

text.p: Team Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a letter of intent to sell 50 percent of its outstanding shares, on a fully diluted basis, to Wingate Partners LP for $3.125 per share.

The transaction, said the company, is contingent upon the negotiation and consummation by Team of one or more mutually approved but as yet unidentified business acquisitions, mutually acceptable definitive agreements, further due diligence, and director, shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Wingate is a Dallas-based private equity investment partnership which holds controlling interests in a number of manufacturing, distribution and service businesses.
Team provides specialized industrial services at 40 customer service locations in 23 states and through subsidiaries in England and Trinidad.
